title: Kissed Caramel Japanese Hazelnuts Ehomaki
description: A tender and indulgent Japanese dish featuring shelled hazelnuts, caramelized to perfection and wrapped in a delicate Ehomaki roll, this low-calorie-friendly treat is perfect for any occasion. The combination of resinous and sweet flavors creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread the hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast for 10 minutes.
In a saucepan, combine the sugar, water, and 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the hazelnuts from the oven and let them cool.
Caramelize the hazelnuts by tossing them in the sugar mixture until they are evenly coated.
Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Assemble the Ehomaki rolls by spreading a thin layer of sushi rice onto a noru sheet, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange the caramelized hazelnuts in the center of the rice.
Roll the Ehomaki using a bamboo sushi mat.
Slice the roll into 8 equal pieces.
